question: Under which category did Ricky Kej secure his third Grammy award?

options.text: Best Audio Album of the year

solution:
The correct answer is __**Best Immersive Audio Album**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ricky Kej won his third Grammy award in the **Best Immersive Audio Album** category for his album titled **"Divine Tides."**
 
• The album "Divine Tides" is a collaboration between Ricky Kej and **Stewart Copeland**, the legendary drummer of the band "The Police."
 
• Ricky Kej is a renowned Indian musician and environmentalist known for his dedication to creating music that promotes sustainability and environmental awareness.
 
• This win further solidified Ricky Kej’s position as a globally recognized artist and advocate for environmental causes.
 
• The Grammys are one of the most prestigious awards in the music industry, recognizing excellence in musical achievement across various categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Best Immersive Audio Album**:

 
 
• This category recognizes works that utilize advanced audio technologies to create immersive and spatial sound experiences for listeners.
 
• Immersive audio includes formats such as Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, and other surround sound technologies.
 
 
 
• **Ricky Kej’s Environmental Advocacy**:
 
 
• Ricky Kej’s music often carries themes of environmental conservation and sustainability.
 
• He has collaborated with various global organizations, including the United Nations, to raise awareness about ecological issues.
 
 
 
• **Stewart Copeland:**
 
 
• Stewart Copeland is a legendary musician best known for his role as the drummer of the Grammy-winning band "The Police."
 
• His collaboration with Ricky Kej on "Divine Tides" blends global music styles with immersive soundscapes.
 
 
 
• **The Grammy Awards:**
 
 
• The Grammy Awards are presented annually by the Recording Academy to honor artistic and technical excellence in the music industry.
 
• They include categories spanning genres, production techniques, and global music contributions.
